offering_description.value: Develops and commercializes therapies for rare genetic diseases, including enzyme replacement, peptide and gene therapies. Sells to specialist physicians, hospitals and patients, with products reaching patients through specialty distributors and pharmacies.

primary_products.value: enzyme replacement therapies; peptide therapies; gene therapy for hemophilia A; growth-regulating therapy for achondroplasia

customer_segment.value: B2B: specialty pharmacies, hospitals, clinics and specialist physicians; B2C: patients with rare genetic diseases and their families

revenue_model.value: product sales: prescription therapies sold to distributors, pharmacies and hospitals

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: develops and markets its own drugs, sold to distributors, pharmacies and hospitals; OEM / manufacturer: produces therapies, partly through contract manufacturers, sold to specialty distributors and pharmacies

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Japan, Latin America, Middle East and other countries

specialization.value: related lines: rare disease therapies across enzyme replacement, peptide, gene therapy and skeletal disease treatments, sharing specialist physician customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: specialist sales force selling to physicians and hospitals; distributors / dealers: specialty pharmaceutical distributors; third-party retail: specialty pharmacies dispensing to patients
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: high: drug approvals and licenses needed to sell therapies, regulated by the FDA and EMA and other national health authorities
